## Summary

I am Alex, a third year student at State University studying
computer science. My interest in technology began in high school
when I built my first web application. This passion has driven me to
explore various domains of software development.

I have experience in multiple programming languages - Python,
JavaScript, Go & TypeScript. I have used Python extensively for
building machine learning pipelines, creating REST APIs (using

and data processing. Additionally, I have full-stack development
experience with React and Node.js.

Some of my notable open source contributions include CloudSync

data-parser (200k+ downloads on PyPi). I have also contributed to
popular open-source projects like Kubernetes and TensorFlow.
